author: Atari
text:
IF, in answering your question, a FL limit can only be drawn after the
 TG has been hit. In this case TG (UFL) has been hit. Therefore, the
green box (LFL) is now an confirmed FL. The engulf downward is not
significant. It is just part of retracement in the creation of the LFL
(green box). The LFL (green box) is just the left shoulder, assuming
that price does not break above the UFL and decides to come down and
engulf the green box. So, we now have to wait for price to come down
from the TG (UFL) and engulf the LFL (green box) for PA. Otherwise, if
price continues going up and break above the UFL, the green box is just
another LFL.

1. If we do not hit the target and we rely on the FTR I drew as a level
or its MPL, there is eevery chance the FTR may make a larger kink before
 hitting the target. and retrace further past what we thought was the
FTR This will become more evident once the course has been uploaded.

2. What are TGs. Exactly the same as the entry areas we look at for PA.
So they can be: kinks (FLs) of Highs/Lows, Pre CP, kinks after CP and
Left Shoulders. We need to be conservative and mark any of these as a
TG. BUT we for our entries we should only use the best. Like a FL kink
that lines up with a left shoulder and Hi/Low kink or with a CP zone
etc. I will illustrate in a few hours
